acceptance_criteria: Pin Hey API 0.97.3 and use embedded Fetch, removing external Fetch and vulnerable resolutions. Synchronize direct inventory and notices. Validate the exact MIT patch classification, upstream attribution and direct dependency correspondence.
Preserve strict TypeScript options and public HTTP contract, operations and consumed exports. Limit consumer adaptations to migration needs.
Patch the generator only if indispensable, via reproducible pnpm patch, preserving property omission semantics and the upstream security fix.
Prove deterministic generation in two disposable environments and validate the emitted runtime against the advisory exploit.
Pass frozen installation, OpenAPI check/diff, typecheck, consumer tests, build, audit, make verify and hosted CI.
Submit one technical PR and require QA, Reviewer, Security Review and applicable DAA on the final SHA before Owner-gated merge. Verify alerts #17/#18 fixed before closing #1020.
